about: The curated node catalog the material validator (NameTBDAIMaterialGraph) checks graphs against. Pin and output names are matched against the engine's own (reflection) at run time; 'aka' are names models often use instead. 'out' is the output width rule: a number, 'max:Pins' (inputs broadcast, scalars mix with anything), 'same:Pin', 'sum:Pins' (AppendVector), 'mask' (ComponentMask channels). A pin with 'def' is optional (the engine uses that value when it isn't wired); 'w' is the width a pin takes: '1', '2', '3', '1|out' (scalar or the node's own width), 'any'.

Multiply.about: A * B (a scalar scales a vector)

LinearInterpolate.about: Lerp: A where Alpha=0, B where Alpha=1

Power.about: Base ^ Exponent (sharpens a 0..1 mask when Exponent > 1)

SmoothStep.about: 0 below Min, 1 above Max, smooth between - soft edges. Min must be below Max (it never falls): for 1 below and 0 above, OneMinus it

Sine.about: sin(2*pi*Input / Period); Period 1 by default, so Input = Time * Speed waves Speed times a second

Arctangent2.about: atan2(Y, X) in radians - angle around a center (conic sweeps)

Distance.about: distance between A and B (UV to a center = round shapes)

ComponentMask.about: keeps some channels: props {channels: "rg"} (or R/G/B/A true)

AppendVector.about: joins A and B into a wider vector (float2 + float = float3)

TextureCoordinate.about: UV of the widget: (0,0) top left, (1,1) bottom right; props {tiling: [u, v]}

Panner.about: UV scrolling over time: props {speed: [x, y]}

Rotator.about: UV rotating over time around a center: props {speed, center: [x, y]}

Time.about: seconds since start (always rising) - drive motion with Time * Speed

Noise.about: smooth noise of a float3 Position (in UI: UV * Scale, appended with 0); props {Scale, Levels, OutputMin 0, OutputMax 1}

SphereMask.about: 1 near B, falling to 0 at Radius from it (A = UV, B = center)

VertexColor.about: the widget's tint / the particle's color: outputs RGB (default), R, G, B, A

Constant.about: a number (or just write the number as the input)

Constant2Vector.about: a float2 (or write [x, y] as the input)

Constant3Vector.about: an RGB color (or write "#RRGGBB" as the input)

ScalarParameter.about: a number an instance can change: props {ParameterName, DefaultValue} - or write {"param": "Name", "value": 0.5} as any input

VectorParameter.about: a color an instance can change: outputs RGB (default), R, G, B, A - or write {"param": "Name", "value": "#hex"} as any input

TextureSampleParameter2D.about: a texture an instance can change: outputs RGB (default), R, G, B, A, RGBA; props {ParameterName, Texture}

TextureSample.about: a fixed texture: outputs RGB (default), R, G, B, A, RGBA; props {Texture}

ConstantBiasScale.about: (Input + Bias) * Scale - maps -1..1 to 0..1 with Bias 1, Scale 0.5

MaterialFunctionCall.about: a library Material Function (function: SoftCircle, RoundedRectSDF, PanningNoise, ColorRamp) or one by path; inputs/outputs by the function's own names

Custom.about: HLSL escape hatch: {code: "return a * b;", output: float1|float2|float3|float4, inputs {a: ref, b: ref}} - input names are the code's variables

FunctionInput.about: a Material Function's input (function graphs only)

FunctionOutput.about: a Material Function's output (function graphs only)
